keySentence: The emperor loved fine clothes more than anything.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The cloth was invisible. No one could see it. But they all lied. The emperor loved fine clothes more than anything.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The swindlers pretended to weave on an empty loom. The emperor sent his best minister to check the cloth. The minister saw nothing but was too afraid to say so. The emperor loved fine clothes more than anything in the world. He visited the weavers himself and also saw nothing. But nobody dared to tell the truth about the invisible cloth.
facts.Word cards: emperor = 임금님 / beautiful = 아름다운 / new = 새로운 / clothes = 옷 / more than anything = 무엇보다
